description: This PHP class handles recurring calendar events, providing methods to manipulate event timings, calculate recurrence intervals, and generate repeated event instances based on recurrence rules.

classes.name: Calendar_RepeatEvents
classes.description: A class for managing repetitive calendar events, including calculating time intervals and generating recurring event instances.

methods.name: mktime
methods.description: Converts a datetime string into a Unix timestamp.

methods.name: nexttime
methods.description: Calculates the next event time based on a base timing and an interval.

methods.name: formattime
methods.description: Formats a datetime string into the user-specific date and time format.

methods.name: splittime
methods.description: Splits a full timing string into date and time components.

methods.name: getRepeatInterval
methods.description: Calculates a list of intervals for recurring events based on the recurrence type and frequency.

methods.name: repeat
methods.description: Generates repeated activity instances until a specified limit based on recurrence rules.

methods.name: repeatFromRequest
methods.description: Initiates the recurrence process based on data from a web request.
